claims.claim: ModernBERT incorporates RoPE, GeGLU, alternating local-global attention and unpadding.
claims.verification_note: Architectural and systems changes are joint, not independent controlled effect claims.

claims.claim: ModernBERT released model supports up to 8192 tokens in its native context configuration.
claims.verification_note: Token length depends on checkpoint tokenizer and max sequence config.

claims.claim: Alternating attention commonly has a global layer every 3 layers and local window around 128 tokens in reference recipe.
claims.verification_note: Pattern/size version-specific; tutorial 8-token demo is not the production window.

claims.claim: ModernBERT uses GeGLU as a gated feed-forward layer rather than standard BERT GELU-only FFN.
claims.verification_note: Width and parameters differ from conventional FFN; equations shown conceptually.

claims.claim: RoPE rotates query and key vectors according to positions and modifies their dot product.
claims.verification_note: Not directly rotating token IDs or guaranteeing unlimited extrapolation.

claims.claim: Unpadding and packing reduce padding waste but require preserving sample boundaries.
claims.verification_note: Attention masks must prevent inter-example leakage in packed batches.
